verdict.rationale: Vue can be used as a single small script with no build tools or package manager (vue-comm-6), and its progressive/incremental adoption model supports minimal footprint use, but other evidence highlights dependency on build tooling and an ecosystem (router, Vuex) that adds weight for typical apps. missing for 10: no documented bundle-size benchmarks, no explicit supply-chain/security analysis of dependency tree, no independent audit of runtime footprint versus competitors.
